value.rationale: This is a structurally motivated exact enclosing-ball classification of a canonical unweighted 2-graph polytope family introduced in 2022, at the first connected-triple stage beyond graphical zonotopes. It gives a unique high-dimensional Euclidean center, two qualitatively different complete contact orbits (q! versus two points), an exact total vertex census and a contact proportion asymptotic to \(1/(2e q)\). The global algebraic inequality and exceptional equality set are not a relabeling, arbitrary slice or known table recitation. The application is deliberately limited to \(Q_{K_{2,q},2}\); no broader paper-sized theorem is asserted.
